page.layout: One page of running text, two-column notes: one margin note at the right, aligned with the paragraph about Chrysostom. Several small marginal references (numbers 17, 22, 10, 11, 12, 13 printed at line ends in the right margin). Catchword "uti" at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.l: ψηθέντων.&c. Et v.13. τὸν Ἰακὼβ
ἠγάπησα, τὸν δὲ Ἡσαῦ ἐμίσησα. Quid ni urgeremus, ad
removendam originem differentiæ ab
hominibus; quæ nulla est, ideóque nec
ejus prævisio: & ponendam in
posito secundum electionem, & meram ejus
voluntatem; ut habet contextus? Ad
eum locum, inquit, quasi contrà, Chrysostomus:
Quòd justè, (Jacob dilexit; Esau odio ha-
buit:) tu quidem ex fine cognovisti. Quo?
Dei ne? an ex eventu? Illum nos urge-
mus, ex contextu, v.17, 22. De hoc iste
pergit: Novit autem idem (ita enim ver-
tendum) perspicuè etiam ante finem. Non
enim solum Deus quærit operum demonstrati-
onem; sed & voluntatis generositatem, & sen-
sum rectum. Sed unde hæc ei (Jacobo)
voluntas & mens, præ Esau: cùm in hu-
manis sit ἀξιόσ; ut patet ex v.10. &
11? Non nisi ex Dei secundum electionem pro-
positò, v.11. Ex vocante. v.12. Si enim es-
set ex ipsis, secundum prævisionem: non
adscripsisset Apostolus Deo soli. Hoc
autem colligere est ex ipsomet Chryso-
stomi contextu. Unde enim est; quòd,
uti

page.notes: Greek text in the first line is partly uncertain (Ἰακὼβ / ἠγάπησα / Ἡσαῦ / ἐμίσησα; the accent on ἀξιόσ is doubtful, marked as read). Marginal note "Chrysostomus" at right is a running marginal gloss, rendered as a note. Marginal numbers 33, 11, 12 at line ends are section markers. Several words in the text are unclear and not marked individually; the transcription should be checked against the scan.
